```{r set file directories - local}
dir.create(file.path("deluge"), showWarnings = F)
dir.create(file.path("deluge","data"), showWarnings = F)
dir.create(file.path("deluge","data","R_exports"))
dir.create(file.path("deluge","figures"))
```

```{r read in continuous files - choose 2 to refresh connection}
drive.files<-googledrive::drive_ls(googledrive::as_id("https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dmzGwkGC1Y4uWW8nLXDkhtB_4A4suyF3?usp=drive_link"))

cont.files<-c("GCC_filtered.csv","SR_filtered.csv","VWC_20cm_filtered.csv","deluge_characteristics_mergeable.csv","deluge_trt_keys.csv","continuous_response_calcs.csv","continuous_response_calcs_thresh10.csv")

## read in each file
for (i in cont.files){
  
file.name<-drive.files %>% 
  dplyr::filter(name == i) 

# if-else, to throw error if file name is incorrect or error would otherwise stop loop
if(nrow(file.name) == 1){
  googledrive::drive_download(file = file.name$id, 
                              overwrite = T,
                              path = file.path("deluge", 'data', 'R_exports', i))
  
} else{
  message("File error - check name or if duplicated: ", i)
  }
}

```

```{r check files}
#### read in data already averaged to daily scale
calcs<-read.csv("deluge/data/R_exports/continuous_response_calcs.csv")
glimpse(calcs)

calcs.10<-read.csv("deluge/data/R_exports/continuous_response_calcs_thresh10.csv")
glimpse(calcs.10)

#### prep data - responses should be GCC and SR - predictors: size*VWC_AUC + timing (doy) + (1|Year) 
## filter to what we want to keep
selected.responses<-calcs%>%
  select("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt","con","del_size","timing","del_start","diff_AUC28","diff_AUC28_daily","new_resp_length","new_resp_lag_days","diff_AUCthresh","diff_AUCthresh_daily")
glimpse(selected.responses)

selected.responses.10<-calcs.10%>%
  select("Variable","Study_shorthand","year","trt","con","del_size","timing","del_start","diff_AUC28","diff_AUC28_daily","new_resp_length","new_resp_lag_days","diff_AUCthresh","diff_AUCthresh_daily")
glimpse(selected.responses.10)

## pivot wider for making regressions
resp.dat<-selected.responses%>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols=c(Study_shorthand, year, trt, con, del_size, timing, del_start),
    names_from=Variable,
    values_from=c(starts_with("diff_AUC"), new_resp_length, new_resp_lag_days),
    names_glue="{Variable}_{.value}")%>%
  mutate(del_start=as.Date(del_start,format="%Y-%m-%d"),
         doy=yday(del_start))

glimpse(resp.dat)
# view(resp.dat)

resp.dat.10<-selected.responses.10%>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols=c(Study_shorthand, year, trt, con, del_size, timing, del_start),
    names_from=Variable,
    values_from=c(starts_with("diff_AUC"), new_resp_length, new_resp_lag_days),
    names_glue="{Variable}_{.value}")%>%
  mutate(del_start=as.Date(del_start,format="%Y-%m-%d"),
         doy=yday(del_start))

glimpse(resp.dat.10)
# view(resp.dat.10)

#### filtered to 60mm deluges only
resp.dat.60<-resp.dat%>%
  filter(del_size==60)

resp.dat.10.60<-resp.dat.10%>%
  filter(del_size==60)

#### summary tables
resp.avs.gs<-selected.responses%>%
  filter(!timing=="fall")%>%
  group_by(Variable)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.studies=n(),
    AUC_28_daily=mean(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_28_SE=(sd(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    elevated_20perc_length=mean(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE),
    el_20perc_SE=(sd(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    AUC_el_period_daily=mean(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_el_period_SE=(sd(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    lag_days=mean(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE),
    lag_SE=(sd(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE)))

resp.avs.gs.10<-selected.responses.10%>%
  filter(!timing=="fall")%>%
  group_by(Variable)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.studies=n(),
    AUC_28_daily=mean(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_28_SE=(sd(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    elevated_20perc_length=mean(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE),
    el_20perc_SE=(sd(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    AUC_el_period_daily=mean(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_el_period_SE=(sd(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    lag_days=mean(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE),
    lag_SE=(sd(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE))
  )

resp.avs.fall<-selected.responses%>%
  filter(timing=="fall")%>%
  group_by(Variable)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.studies=n(),
    AUC_28_daily=mean(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_28_SE=(sd(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    elevated_20perc_length=mean(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE),
    el_20perc_SE=(sd(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    AUC_el_period_daily=mean(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_el_period_SE=(sd(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    lag_days=mean(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE),
    lag_SE=(sd(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE)))

resp.avs.fall.10<-selected.responses.10%>%
  filter(timing=="fall")%>%
  group_by(Variable)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.studies=n(),
    AUC_28_daily=mean(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_28_SE=(sd(diff_AUC28_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    elevated_20perc_length=mean(new_resp_length,na.rm=TRUE),

    AUC_el_period_daily=mean(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE),
    AUC_el_period_SE=(sd(diff_AUCthresh_daily,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n.studies)),
    lag_days=mean(new_resp_lag_days,na.rm=TRUE),

  )

```

Linear regressions for each response (normalized) ~ deluge size, timing (early/mid/late/fall), timing (deluge addition days relative to peak GCC?)
- Responses:
  - Length: number of days of response (over threshold – relalive 20%) 
  - Magnitude: AUC of whole length for each study (instead of 28 day response periods) + explanatory variable as length of response 
  - Relative response/pulses: AUC divided by # of days of response
Just do these responses for SR and GCC, including VWC as an explanatory variable -- GCC AUC from threshold all 0

Models (for SR and GCC):
- Length_days ~ size*VWC_AUC + timing (doy (or relative to peak GCC)) + (1|Year)
- AUC_with_length ~ size*VWC_AUC + timing + (1|Year)
- Standardized_AUC ~ size*VWC_AUC + timing + (1|Year)

Do with and without fall deluges? 
Do with and without Mary’s data – check to see how influential it is

#### response ~ size*VWC + timing + (1|year)
```{r length}
### GCC -- no responses over threshold (use 28 day period only)
### SR **********
mod<-lmer(SR_new_resp_length~del_size*VWC_diff_AUC28+as.factor(timing)+(1|year),data=resp.dat)
plot(mod)
qqnorm(resid(mod));qqline(resid(mod))
anova(mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # drop interaction

mod.ni<-lmer(SR_new_resp_length~del_size+VWC_diff_AUC28+as.factor(timing)+(1|year),data=resp.dat)
plot(mod.ni)
qqnorm(resid(mod.ni));qqline(resid(mod.ni))
anova(mod.ni,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # size 0.0013, timing 0.055885

### SR - doy ************
mod<-lmer(SR_new_resp_length~del_size*VWC_diff_AUC28+doy+(1|year),data=resp.dat)
plot(mod)
qqnorm(resid(mod));qqline(resid(mod))
anova(mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # drop interaction

mod.ni<-lmer(SR_new_resp_length~del_size+VWC_diff_AUC28+doy+(1|year),data=resp.dat)
plot(mod.ni)
qqnorm(resid(mod.ni));qqline(resid(mod.ni))
anova(mod.ni,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # size 0.0002, doy 0.002

### SR - 60mm only *********
mod<-lmer(SR_new_resp_length~VWC_diff_AUC28+(1|year),data=resp.dat.60)
plot(mod)
qqnorm(resid(mod));qqline(resid(mod))
anova(mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # not sig

### SR - doy
mod<-lmer(SR_new_resp_length~VWC_diff_AUC28+doy+(1|year),data=resp.dat.60)
plot(mod)
qqnorm(resid(mod));qqline(resid(mod))
anova(mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # none sig
```
